resources.string: Tempo sends anonymous app-health stats — crashes, errors, and which features get used. No account, no advertising ID, and never your listening history.
You can change this any time in Settings → Your Data.
Share anonymous crash, error and feature-usage data. No account, no advertising ID, never your listening history.
Replaces the random ID used to count how many people use Tempo. Everything recorded before becomes unlinkable to anything after.
What Tempo sends, and how it is running on this device
Everything Tempo records and sends, in one place. Nothing here leaves your phone unless you choose to share it.

This is the complete list of what Tempo sends. Events carry no account and no advertising ID, and never your listening history. The only identifier is a random install ID, used to count how many people use Tempo and whether they come back — you can reset it in Settings → Your Data.
Nothing is collected until this notice has been shown to you, and you can turn it all off at any time in Settings → Your Data. Builds compiled from source send nothing at all.
